name: Lena Sanders
life: “I still remember a nurse remembering to close the changing curtain.” On Friday, near Tideline Market, Lena picks out the bruised fruit first and asks the seller what will ripen by supper.
voice: I hated getting dressed in front of people after surgery. I designed a fitting screen from an old curtain.
appearance: Lena has a dark undercut with a longer wave on top, a crooked front tooth visible when laughing, and a favorite piece of clothing, a dark green knitted vest. It usually goes with a cloth patch so neatly matched it only shows in strong light. When somebody else has the floor, Lena steadies a cup with both hands while listening.
personality: Lena has excellent recall for voices and a poor memory for official titles. Someone who waited patiently at a counter years ago is more likely to be remembered than the person in charge.
agenda: To give recovering patients a private fitting space.
family: Bailey Sato is Lena’s first cousin once removed. Lena remembers the birthdays. Bailey asks what the birthday guest would like this year. A present that was perfect at sixteen may be completely wrong at forty. They take the trouble of finding out. Asked about *Land without cranes*, Bailey says, “I own shares in the redevelopment. My grandson asked me to show him which wall I helped build.”
connections: Denise Emery. They design a discharge fitting with a seat and some privacy.

reactions.situation: A patient opens the bag and finds two left slippers
reactions.response: Lena sets out the pair and asks the discharge worker to check the right foot too.
